subject: Promote native AgentSession/ReceiptEnvelope contracts into the live supervisor path

required_actions: Stop treating bf_agent_contract as only a native test surface. Route live Claude and Codex epochs through AgentSession event-frontier construction and ReceiptEnvelope validation before semantic completion.
Bind model-turn, context-compaction and strategy-change events to the stable AgentSession identity; provider process IDs/wrappers remain physical carriers only.
Require receipt continuity across provider/model substitution, context compaction and transport changes. Gaps or origin substitution remain hard failures.

Project the same frontier into Restate/WorkerRun/ProtocolMachine lifecycle state where those registered paths exist, so runtime recovery and replay consume one contract rather than duplicate state machines.
Use one current Claude epoch and one current Codex epoch as real fixtures; prove identical lifecycle semantics with different provider carriers.
Emit a SolvedInvariant/RegressionFence only after the live supervisor path—not just Zig/C tests—passes.
body.anti_duplication: Reuse the existing native schema and Atlas architectures; do not create another agent receipt type.
